whatWasRead: The two families' committed matrix rows, the derivation of requiredComponentsMissing in verify-packet-completeness.mjs, the MD conditional adapter, both packet-set manifest entries, both source receipts, both product-wiring records, and the raw per-fixture audit of all 43 fixtures run by this lane rather than read off any prior report.
whyNotTheBytesTheCentralRasterCarries: Not asked by this lane and not claimed. No delivered byte changed, so whatever the raster record already binds it still binds. product-wiring.json for md_10110_conviction-set carries an acceptanceReceipt bound to exactly the canonical and boundary digests this lane hashed, but this lane did not verify that receipt and makes no claim on it.
howBytesWereMeasured: sha256sum over the delivered canonical and boundary PDFs before and after. Determinism control: both builders re-run unmodified from this base into their real output directories, 43 PDFs and every report reproduced byte-for-byte with git status --porcelain empty after each run. No raster was rendered by this lane; none was needed.
everyZeroHasAPositiveControl: Yes. The repaired counter reads 0 because auditPreparedInputs was run over all 43 fixtures and returned 0 with no component finding on every one, while the SAME code path returns real nonzero readings on the diagnostic fixtures (unclassifiedBlanks 1 on diagnostic/waiver-missing-financial, knownRequiredFieldsMissing 1 on diagnostic/missing-completion) -- so the zero is a measurement, not a silent path. Seven guards were broken deliberately and every one fired, with an unbroken control accepted first and the manifest restored byte-identical: a declared component no fixture delivers (both through an injected manifest and through the real file on disk), a delivered component neither declared nor recorded, a family absent from the manifest, a real failing counter on a prepared fixture, a nonzero counter smuggled under a PASS_COMPLETE, a null counter the classifier did not declare unmeasured, and an unrelated unexpected result class.
rasterPixelCountsWhyNull: This lane rendered no raster. The repair is a measurement fix and cost zero bytes; visualDefects stays null for both families and only the central raster gate can settle it.
grantsNothing: This lane repaired a measurement. It promotes no family, opens no commercial route, claims no raster, and its own PASS is not evidence -- independent re-verification is owed to a lane that is not this one.
conditionsOnApprovedForLive: Both families carry an undeclared delivered component (MDJ-008). Neither may reach approved_for_live, a commercial route or a participant until the packet-set manifest and the delivered set agree, whichever way that is resolved.
outOfScopeObservedNotActedOn: The identical exception sink exists verbatim in scripts/rcap-packet-completeness/ky-native-candidate.mjs:29-33 and scripts/rcap-packet-completeness/md-favorable-native-candidate.mjs:60-66, for ky_nonconviction_expungement-set and md_10105_favorable-set. Not this lane's families; not touched.

The catch in the MD adapter still borrows requiredComponentsMissing to refuse an unaudited family, now labelled as a borrow rather than a component reading. Retiring it needs generate-raster-queue.mjs:823-828 to refuse an unaudited family directly. That rule currently treats a null nonvisual counter as passing, and 19 families queued today have a null invisibleWrites, so tightening it would un-enrol families this lane does not own.

NOT_MEASURABLE_HERE is a live return value at verify-packet-completeness.mjs:664 and is absent from RESULT_CLASSES in completeness-contract.mjs, so the matrix's own declared class list does not contain a class 27 of its rows now carry.

Regenerating the full matrix also picked up a 2-line drift on al-felony-dwop-set that exists at this base independently of this lane: REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING 56 -> 55 and NOT_APPLICABLE_ON_THIS_ROUTE 7 -> 8 in blanksByDisposition. Its result is PASS_COMPLETE before and after. The verifier writes the whole file or nothing, so it could not be excluded; the Captain may drop it.

The sink was erasing the factory's aggregate readings, not only two rows: counterTotals went from six nulls to real numbers (knownRequiredFieldsMissing 0, requiredFactsNotCollected 1, unclassifiedBlanks 15, incompleteRows 0, requiredOptionsMissing 4, protectedWrites 0). Factory-wide requiredComponentsMissing is now 0, and every occurrence it ever had was this sink.

rows.whichOfTheThreeOutcomesHeld: B, on the counter -- the component is delivered and the counter could not see it -- AND, separately and additionally, C on the manifest: a delivered component the manifest does not declare.

theCounterWasNotCountingComponents.whatThatStringIs: An assert.equal message from scripts/rcap-packet-completeness/md-conditional-native-candidates.mjs:143 comparing a RESULT CLASS, not a document. It names no component because no component was measured.
theCounterWasNotCountingComponents.whereTheOneCameFrom: auditMdConditionalCandidate's catch block relabelled every throw as requiredComponentsMissing:1 and overwrote the other eight measured counters with null.
theCounterWasNotCountingComponents.howMeasured: auditPreparedInputs run directly over all 25 prepared and diagnostic fixtures of this family. requiredComponentsMissing is 0 on every one, with zero component findings; the only null counter on any fixture is visualDefects.
theCounterWasNotCountingComponents.whyTheRawResultWasNotAPass: verify-packet-completeness.mjs:664 returns NOT_MEASURABLE_HERE as its LAST branch, over a would-be pass, when a counter could not be measured. visualDefects is null because no artifact record in reports/actual-writes.json carries nonWhitespaceGlyphsOutsideMeasuredWriteBoxes -- the geometry pass has not run over these bytes, and the central raster gate is what runs it.

otherEightCounters.before: null (erased by the catch after being measured)
otherEightCounters.after: measured; every one 0 except visualDefects, which stays null

rows.whyNoFreshRasterIsOwed: No delivered byte changed. Both builders were re-run unmodified from this base with MASTER_LIBRARY_SOURCE_DIR set and reproduced all 25 fixture PDFs and every report byte-for-byte (git status --porcelain empty after each). The repair is entirely in the measurement.
rows.howThatWasEstablished: generate-raster-queue.mjs:822-828 replicated line for line against this family's MASTER_QUEUE state (BUILT_RASTER_PENDING) and its NEW matrix counters: nonVisual is empty and comp is present, so no eligibility reason is raised. RASTER_QUEUE.json's current notEligible entry for this family lists that counter as its ONLY reason, so every other precondition already passed. NOT run: MASTER_QUEUE.json and RASTER_QUEUE.json are shared manifests this lane is forbidden to write, and they still carry the old counters until the Captain regenerates them.

manifestVersusDelivered.whatMDJ008Is: Maryland Judiciary form MDJ-008, 'Notice Regarding Restricted Information Pursuant to Rule 20-201.1', edition 07/2026, read from the retained source face at reference/chat-parallel-2026-09-07/chat5/MDJ-008.pdf sha256 42510792803b979974b3967dfd0f871271e7518cf64e226d5a80e22b67a6e369.
manifestVersusDelivered.howItReachesAParticipant: Bound into the delivered PDF with role restricted_information_notice on every waiver fixture -- 11 of 25 fixtures, including boundary.pdf -- and named in that fixture's instructions.
manifestVersusDelivered.whyNoCounterSeesIt: requiredComponentsMissing compares this family's own field map and source receipt against the render. MDJ-008 is in both, so it reads zero, correctly. Nothing in the completeness contract opens the packet-set manifest.
manifestVersusDelivered.whatTheRepoRecordsAboutIt: source-receipt.json: conditionalComponent names it; globalRelationshipCorrection says 'A-owned; MDJ-008 conditional addition requested in comment5574693015'. session08/md-conviction-author-handoff.json lists 'A conditional MDJ-008 source relationship from comment5574693015' under pending. SOURCE_RELATIONSHIP_REGISTRY.json does not mention it. product-wiring.json lists it in binding.packetComponents but omits it from binding.sourceVersion.
manifestVersusDelivered.notResolvedHere: This lane did not add MDJ-008 to the packet-set manifest. Declaring a component is a legal-design decision the repo itself records as pending and A-owned, and authoring the declaration here would be fabricating one.
manifestVersusDelivered.whatItBlocks: Promotion. RASTER_PASS grants nothing and delivers nothing to a participant, so this does not block enrolment into the visual gate; it does block approved_for_live, any commercial route and any participant delivery until the manifest and the delivered set agree.

verifierActualVerdict.theVerdictIsNotAPass: NOT_MEASURABLE_HERE is not PASS_COMPLETE, and the verifier prints FAIL beside it for any result that is not PASS_COMPLETE. The exit status is 0 in both cases and proves nothing either way: this script exits nonzero only for an unmatched --family or a failed mutation suite, never for a failing row.

whatMustBeRepairedBySomeoneElse: The packet-set manifest and the delivered set disagree about MDJ-008 for this family. Either declare it as a conditional component of md_10110_conviction-set or stop delivering it.
visualDefects stays null. Only the central raster gate can settle it, which is what enrolment is for.

MDJ-008 is absent from data/rcap-grade-a/packet-factory-24h/SOURCE_RELATIONSHIP_REGISTRY.json and from product-wiring.json binding.sourceVersion, though it is bound to an exact sha in source-receipt.json.
